recent_years.unlock_rule: every frozen 2021-2023 development gate must pass

source.provider: U.S. Treasury Bureau of the Fiscal Service
source.availability: first SPY cash session strictly after official auction_date

feature.comparison_bucket: security_type plus exact security_term plus floating-rate flag plus inflation-index flag
feature.dealer_share_surprise: current share minus immediately preceding share in comparison bucket
feature.rate_exposure_years: issue_date to maturity_date days divided by 365.25; floating-rate securities fixed at 0.25
feature.daily_shock: sum auction_shock by auction_date, then sum again if multiple auction dates map to one next cash session
feature.direction: positive shock selects SPXU; negative shock selects UPRO; exact zero is cash

controls.accepted_notional_only: same share surprise and aggregation without rate-exposure years
controls.fixed_coupon_only: retain Note and Bond rows with floating_rate not Yes
controls.extra_session_lag: move the unchanged primary action one additional cash session later
controls.flipped_direction: same dates and clocks, opposite actuator

event_direction_permutation.method: shuffle primary overhang direction labels across mapped event sessions while preserving the quote-return panel

development_gates: more than 2.0 executed trades per 753/5 declared weeks
at least 95 percent execution coverage after degraded-session exclusions
positive UPRO and SPXU fixed-notional PnL separately
compounded ending cash above adjusted SPY
positive after one extra cent adverse at entry and exit
positive after a five-minute entry delay
positive after deleting the five best mapped auction clusters
positive independent-feed overlap with profit factor above one and both sleeves represented
actual mean trade PnL above accepted-notional-only, fixed-coupon-only, and extra-session-lag controls
prohibited_repairs: delete bills, TIPS, FRNs, notes, bonds, a term, a year, or a side
use when-issued yield or auction-tail data after seeing outcomes
change the next-session entry or exit clock
add a magnitude threshold, price confirmation, stop, weekday, or volatility filter
flip the sign or promote a control
read 2024-2025 after any development gate miss
